Product & design showcase

Two crafts, one institution.

School management software

Student records, attendance, fees, grades, and communications in one place. Built for the way schools actually run: front-office staff, teachers, and administrators each get a view that matches their day.

Custom ID-card printing

Durable PVC cards with your institution's identity, printed and finished to a professional standard. Sample designs shown; every card is made to order.

Software in action

One system, every school day.

Attendance in seconds

Teachers mark attendance from the classroom. Absences surface instantly for the front office, and parents are notified automatically. No registers to collect, no data to re-enter.

Fees without the paperwork

Fee structures, invoices, receipts, and reminders live in one ledger. Staff see who has paid at a glance, and families get clear statements instead of confusing slips.

Messages that reach parents

Announcements, circulars, and urgent alerts go out by SMS and app notification. Delivery is tracked, so the school knows what was seen and what needs a follow-up.

Identity, printed

A card that feels official.

Crisp printing on durable PVC, with your institution's name, logo, and student details. Every card is checked before it ships.

Sample designs shown. Your artwork, your data.

How it works

From first call to first school day.

  1. Requirements

    We map your admissions, attendance, fee, and communication workflows before anything is configured.

  2. Setup

    Student and staff records are imported, fee structures are built, and ID-card artwork is approved.

  3. Onboarding

    Your team is trained on the workflows they will actually use, role by role.

  4. Support

    Ongoing help during school hours, with a direct line to the people who built your setup.
